d:
Ah shit, here we go again.

fucking clockwork.

Every single month, like a glitch in a shitty simulation, we get the same massive wall of text. "Oh, I was mentally pushed to the edge," "Oh, my anxiety is so high I had to ignore my emails."
Translation: "I couldn't be arsed to work, so I ghosted everyone until the guilt—or the lack of cash—hit me."

And right on cue, the Sudden Flu and a little psychosis joins the lazy kingdom.
It’s like a greatest hits album of excuses at this point.
Do people actually still buy this shit? It’s been what, a month since he crawled back, and he’s already setting the stage for the next disappearance.

But wait, here’s the new twist!
Our 'Aiaim' would like to remind you of what we all already knew: He’s not just looking at AI, he’s straight-up living in its shadow. "I have no confidence," "AI does it better," "I’m trying to absorb its style."Give me a fucking break.
"Absorb"? That’s a fancy word for "I’ve given up on having an original thought and I’m just tracing whatever NovelAI spits out now."
Looking at that shite quality, is he even forking out for a proper NovelAI sub? Or does he reckon you fangays aren't worth the subscription fee, so he’s just cheaping out on a local setup instead?
He literally says he picks the AI poses because they’re "better" than his own choices. Why are we even paying a human at this point? We’re basically just funding a guy to play around with prompts and then complain about how "hard" it is to copy the result.

He’s not "incorporating" the style, he’s being swallowed by it.
He’s turned into a human extension of a GPU, and he’s crying because his "retouching" looks like a disjointed mess compared to the machine.
No shit, mate. Maybe if you spent more time drawing and less time writing 5,000-word apologies to your "fangays," you’d actually have a style of your own.

And of course, the doctor told him to "ignore the emails." How convenient! "Professionalism? Sorry, my doctor prescribed me a heavy dose of 'fuck my supporters' for my mental health."

You lot in the comments are absolute muppets.
"Oh, take your time!" "Health comes first!"
He’s literally telling fangays to your face that he’s using AI because he can't be bothered to trust his own skills anymore, and you're still throwing money at his hospital bed. You’re paying to watch a man slowly turn into a CTRL+C, CTRL+V bot.

Deadlines? Dead.
Originality? Buried.
Excuses? Infinite.

Long live aiaim—the king of this delayed, perpetually 'sick' and 'lazy' empire!
See you all next month for the same exact post, just with a different disease and a few more AI-generated artifacts.

Fangays might as well set up a direct debit to his hospital bed at this rate.

Just kidding, AI. Take your sweet time,and still lazy.
We all know it’s just 'support', not like you actually have to do your job.
